decisions.label: Response Declined
decisions.description: Used to indicate when a respondent makes a decision to not answer a question.

verification.note: NCIT:C51024 Response Declined; 'Decline to answer' is functionally equivalent — the respondent chose not to answer. Label differs but concept matches.

decisions.label: Unknown
decisions.description: Not known, observed, recorded, or reported as unknown by the data contributor.

verification.note: NCIT:C17998 Unknown; 'Don't know' expresses uncertainty about one's own biological sex — closest standard NCIT qualifier. No dedicated 'Don't know' term found in NCIT.

decisions.label: Female
decisions.description: An individual who belongs to the sex that normally produces ova.

decisions.label: Intersex
decisions.description: Refers to an individual who was born with genitalia and/or secondary sexual characteristics of indeterminate sex, or which combine features of both sexes.

verification.note: NCIT:C45908 Intersex; exact label match, appropriate for a biological sex vocabulary.

decisions.label: Male
decisions.description: An individual who belongs to the sex that normally produces sperm.

decisions.label: Prefer Not to Answer
decisions.description: A response indicating that an individual prefers or preferred not to answer.

verification.note: NCIT:C132222 Prefer Not to Answer; exact label match.

decisions.label: Unknown
decisions.description: Not known, observed, recorded, or reported as unknown by the data contributor.
